gloss: far from; on the contrary; let alone

definitions.gloss: far from ~; on the contrary; not only not ~
definitions.explanation: Denies the preceding statement and replaces it with something at the opposite extreme: not merely "not X" but in fact the reverse. Attaches to plain-form verbs and adjectives and to bare nouns.

definitions.gloss: let alone ~; to say nothing of ~
definitions.explanation: Used with a negative predicate to say that even a modest case does not hold, so a greater one certainly does not. The item after どころか is the smaller or easier case.

examples.japanese: ⟦{寒|さむ}い→寒い：00664_samui⟧どころか、⟦{暑|あつ}い→暑い：00619_atsui⟧くらいだ。
examples.english: Far from being cold, it's almost hot.

examples.japanese: ⟦{謝|あやま}る→謝る：01177_ayamaru⟧どころか、⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{怒|おこ}り{出|だ}した→怒り出す：29598_okoridasu⟧。
examples.english: Far from apologizing, he got angry.

examples.japanese: ⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}んだ→飲む：00322_nomu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{良|よ}く→良い：02350_yoi⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧どころか⟦{熱|ねつ}→熱：01690_netsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧さらに⟦{上|あ}がって→上がる：00615_agaru⟧しまった。
examples.english: I took the medicine, but far from getting better, my fever went even higher.

examples.japanese: ⟦{漢字|かんじ}→漢字：09480_kanji⟧どころか、ひらがな⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{読|よ}めない→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
examples.english: Let alone kanji, I can't even read hiragana.

examples.japanese: ⟦{海外|かいがい}{旅行|りょこう}→海外旅行：24321_kaigairyokou⟧どころか、{近|ちか}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{温泉|おんせん}→温泉：04117_onsen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: To say nothing of a trip abroad, I don't even have time to visit a nearby hot spring.

examples.japanese: ⟦{忙|いそが}しくて→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧、{昼|ひる}ごはんどころか⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧さえ⟦なかった→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: I was so busy that, let alone lunch, I didn't even have time to drink water.

notes:
CONNECTION:
- Nouns attach directly: ⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧どころか
- Verbs and i-adjectives take the plain form: ⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧どころか、⟦{寒|さむ}い→寒い：00664_samui⟧どころか
- Na-adjectives take な or the bare stem: ⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧どころか

USAGE:
Sense 1 corrects an expectation and is usually followed by a stronger positive statement; sense 2 leads to a negative predicate such as ⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ or ⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧. The reversal is often reinforced by ⟦むしろ→むしろ：02364_mushiro⟧ or さえ.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦もちろん→もちろん：01224_mochiron⟧: to say nothing of ~ — adds a case to an affirmative statement, whereas どころか denies
- ⟦では→では：02945_deha⟧⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧: not ~ but — a plain correction, without the sense of overturning an expectation
- おろか: let alone (literary) — close to sense 2 but distinctly formal
